entries.zh: 锦缎；大马士革缎（此处指葱色、浅青绿色的缎）
entries.en: damask; figured silk from Damascus; here leek-green damask
to harm, to injure, to damage

entries.zh: 损坏；损伤（使受损、使败坏）
entries.en: to damage, to injure, to spoil

entries.zh: 散；使散开、散乱（散弃而致损）
entries.en: to scatter, to disperse; to damage by scattering
entries.notes: L 栏 esparcidos 前一字涂损（[残]），H 散 与 M guã／R gūn 可互证，唯西语短语原貌不全。

entries.en: to ruin, to spoil utterly, to destroy

entries.zh: 抢掠；劫夺（如盗贼抢夺，使人受损）
entries.en: to rob, to plunder, to despoil (as a thief, to another's damage)
entries.notes: H 栏作「戝賊」（[疑]），M 栏 chiāng chèg 近「搶賊」而末缀 chàt 无对应，L 栏仅 Danar，故取劫夺义。

entries.zh: 荒废；使荒芜废弃；消耗（耗损殆尽）
entries.en: to lay waste, to leave desolate; to consume, to waste away

entries.zh: 毁伤；损伤（尤指伤处受创、伤势加重）
entries.en: to injure, to wound; to aggravate a wound one has

entries.zh: 心肠恶毒；居心行事皆如毒（字面谓脏腑已坏）
entries.en: corrupt at heart, venomous in disposition (lit. the entrails are damaged)

entries.zh: 灾难；灾祸（祸事、不幸的遭遇）

entries.notes: L 栏「Dar.」后仅存 hoviⁿ 残迹，H、M 两栏皆 [残]，R 仅 ìnⁿ，四栏不足互证。

entries.en: to beg, to ask alms; to beseech
entries.notes: L 栏「Dar.」后的限定语残缺，R 栏 guīsⁿ 与 M 栏 quis（乞，khit）不谐，究竟为「给乞者」抑或「乞求」不能定夺。

entries.zh: 赏赐；赐予（上对下给与，所给较次或较低）
entries.en: to bestow, to grant (as a superior, esp. something lesser or inferior)
to relieve, to give alms or relief to (賙濟)
entries.notes: L 栏「com lauor」语义不明（[疑:com/con]）；H 周 当为「賙」，M 栏 chiú chèỹ 近「周濟」（chiu-chè），故取接济义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（残存「度」字，疑为度与、随意给与）
entries.en: [original damaged; gloss uncertain] possibly to hand over / to give at random (度)
entries.notes: M 栏 hōu. l. pōĩ 两处 [残]，R 栏仅 īnⁿ，与 H 度 不能互证；L 栏 dar como quiera 仅示「随意给与」大意。

entries.zh: 打抽丰（打秋风）；借端向人索取财物、收受馈赠
entries.en: to solicit gifts or contributions (打抽豐); to receive gifts by imposing on others

entries.zh: 拍打；击打（以手或物击人）
entries.en: to strike, to beat, to hit
entries.notes: L 栏「Dar dara Cista com Sea.」残损难读，M 栏 Lep. [残]；H 拍 与 R pāⁿ（phah）互证，取击打义。

entries.zh: 拍；（手持扇）拍打、点画作节
entries.en: to tap or beat (with a fan in hand, as if marking time or dots)
